courses.overview: 跨單元連結與比較練習

related.title: 哥本哈根阿邁厄巴克焚化發電廠
related.why: 比較兩個系統的物質或能量收支，列出不可直接沿用的邊界條件。
related.whyEn: Compare material or energy balances and identify boundary conditions that cannot be transferred.
related.difference: 設備尺度、進料組成與品質目標必須分別設定。
related.differenceEn: Equipment scale, feed composition and quality objectives require separate definitions.
practice: 各選一個教學算例，記下輸入、輸出與單位。
對照兩課的系統邊界，說明哪些假設不能沿用。
改變一個輸入，提出量測與失效判據來核對結果。
practiceEn: Choose one worked example from each course and record inputs, outputs and units.
Compare system boundaries and identify assumptions that cannot transfer.
Change one input and propose measurements and failure criteria to check the result.

courses.summary: 北投焚化廠的官方環教介紹使用流程模型、語音與指示燈解說，並強調廢水、煙氣、底渣與飛灰的後續處理。
courses.summaryEn: Beitou official education uses process models, narration and indicators and explains wastewater, flue gas, bottom ash and fly ash treatment.

history.title: 台北北投垃圾焚化廠
history.text: 北投焚化廠的官方環教介紹使用流程模型、語音與指示燈解說，並強調廢水、煙氣、底渣與飛灰的後續處理。
history.textEn: Beitou official education uses process models, narration and indicators and explains wastewater, flue gas, bottom ash and fly ash treatment.

courses.connection: 北投課程以進料秤重到灰渣出廠的整條物流為主線，加入中央控制室判讀與環境教育，要求學徒說清每一股副產物去向。
courses.connectionEn: The Beitou course follows material from weighbridge to ash exit, adding control-room interpretation and environmental education; every residual stream must have a stated destination.
